title: Encode and Decode Strings
description: Design an algorithm to encode a list of strings into a single string and decode it back to the original list.
pseudocode:
1. function encode(strs) { let res = ''; for (let s of strs) res += s.length + '#' + s; return res; }
2. function decode(str) { let res = [], i = 0; while (i < str.length) { let j = i; while (str[j] !== '#') j++; let len = parseInt(str.substring(i, j)); res.push(str.substring(j + 1, j + 1 + len)); i = j + 1 + len; } return res; }
